title: AI Stocks Crack, Yields Fall, Defensives Surge; What’s Next | Cameron Dawson
speaker: Cameron Dawson (CIO, NewEdge Wealth), interviewed by David Lin

macro_themes.view: KOSPI and chip selloff after a blow-off top looks like a distributive top; 2027-28 semi margin estimates (42% to 49% EBIT) look vulnerable and price leads data.
Utilities and staples leading is a risk-off sign and usually a harbinger of weakness elsewhere, not something to cheer.
CCC then high-yield spreads widening signal growth fears; a continued widening makes it hard for equities to rally.
Hot CPI and a 2-year near 5% say the Fed will hike more; October is in play, final call after PPI.
Charts point toward 6% on the 10-year over time, though an equity selloff could spark a relief rally in bonds.
~40% of S&P stocks are 20%+ off highs while the index is ~2% off; the market can roll over before earnings do.

calls.reason: Weak breadth, widening credit spreads, defensive leadership, weak financials and semis, and tighter financial conditions imply more volatility and lower near-term returns; market can roll over before earnings.
calls.quote: given the weakness within financials... semiconductors, we're more attuned to changing that mantra, meaning the market can start to roll over before earnings do

calls.condition: A relief drop in yields could come if equities weaken.
calls.reason: Respects chart work (John Roque, 22V) pointing to 6% on the 10-year, but parabolic moves are unsustainable and an equity selloff could trigger a bond rally.
calls.quote: John Rogge over at 22V, who's been saying 6% on the 10-year, that's what the chart is telling you

calls.instrument_quoted: semiconductor index / KOSPI / memory names (no levels)
calls.reason: After a bubble-style doubling and July correction, a weak bounce then break of support suggests a distributive top; oversold bounces may not persist; supernormal memory margins can't last.
calls.quote: That's not necessarily something that will persist and suggests that we're starting to form some kind of top formations in these names

notes: Host calls today Wednesday Oct 14 (CPI day); recorded after CPI, apparently late-day ('where it closes today'), so after_close is a guess. Title says 'Yields Fall' but in-video 10y was 5.289% and rising. SOX used as ticker for the semiconductor group; she says the slowdown is 'not necessarily our call'. Financials weakness and utilities/staples rally mentioned without explicit trades.
